enemies.name: The Apex Predator
enemies.signature: Commands its surviving Ideons on every move, including Purify. Riven Earth summons a Hollow Sentinel; Hollow Hunger a Ward Leech; Brood summons two Glass Skitters. At most six owned Ideons. Corruptions are warned one move before application; destruction is telegraphed. Direct damage rises by 3 per full cycle and another 4 below half HP. Cycle-end Purify clears damage statuses when needed. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Sustain and rebuild your formation. Clear the Sentinel to attack its owner, repair dangerous spaces, and Recall valuable cards before destruction. Its elemental attacks require several defenses.

death.flavor: The mountain was only the beginning of its hunger.
